saw_lines: Golf buyers choose apparel by how it looks on the course, and they decide in the first second of a scroll.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line and image, before anyone reaches the price or shipping terms.
Your site offers free shipping under $150, yet 0 of 29 ads mention shipping. Open three new ads with that offer and the delivery timing in the first sentence.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers free shipping on orders under $150, yet 0 of 29 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers have no reason to act. Open three new ads with that offer and the delivery timing in the first sentence.
The shipping page explains how orders arrive, yet 0 of 29 ads show it, so first time buyers see no answer. Film one video of the box arriving at a front door and open the ad with that moment.

3 of 24 ads use claim words like clinically, cure and guaranteed results, and those lines are what limit reach. Swap them for what customers noticed, like the clean fit your copy already mentions, and test two versions of each.

None of your 29 ads shows a proof number, so a stranger has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open three new ads with it on the creative.
